plugins.name: auto-optimize
plugins.description: Use when the user wants to automatically iterate on a tunable input (file, prompt, config, or infra setting) by running a programmatic test that emits a metric and keeping mutations that improve it — phrasings like "auto-optimize", "auto research", "tune this prompt", "find the best config", "load test and optimize X", "self-improve this skill". The test can be anything scriptable: eval suite, load test, API call, accuracy benchmark. Mutates, measures, keeps the best, and stops on budget, target, or plateau.
